developer-clients.title: Connect a development client
developer-clients.intro: Use project tools from your editor or CLI. Choose a client to prepare its configuration or view its setup guide.
developer-clients.credential: Ask a project administrator for a dedicated Agent or API token. Set SUMA_MCP_TOKEN only in the client process environment. Agent tokens offer four read tools; API tools follow your current project permissions.
developer-clients.merge: Merge this fragment into {{path}} in your project. Preserve existing servers and review the project, user and organization. A download contains only this fragment.
developer-clients.verify: Reopen the client, review its project trust and MCP approvals, list the tools and read the project overview. Confirm any created draft in suma before continuing its normal review.
developer-clients.downloaded: Fragment prepared for download. Merge it into the target file.
developer-clients.manual_copy: Select and copy the configuration below. The clipboard or download is unavailable.
developer-clients.guide_qoder: In Qoder IDE settings, open MCP → My Servers → Add. Its official guide supports Streamable HTTP. Configure the address and private authorization using the installed client's supported fields. Remote header environment expansion has not been confirmed, so no secret-free file is exported here.
developer-clients.guide_zed: In Zed, open Settings → AI → MCP Servers → Add Remote Server. The official format uses context_servers with url and headers. This stage has not confirmed a project-scoped environment token reference; configure credentials privately in the client after reviewing its settings scope.
developer-clients.guide_workbuddy: Use WorkBuddy's official connector guide and confirm the installed client version. A token connector requires its declared credential form and compatible fields. This stage does not generate, upload or install a WorkBuddy connector package.
developer-clients.guide_harness: Harness is an execution runtime, not a universal MCP client format. The existing Octop Harness / ACP setup above configures suma's controlled runtime. Follow Octop's official project for its own client and connector setup; other products named Harness need their own verified contract.
developer-clients.guide_boundary: Use the official guide to review the exact client and authentication fields. A listed client does not mean its account, installation or connection has been verified.
developer-clients.unconfigured: Ask an administrator to configure SUMA_PUBLIC_URL, then refresh. The browser will not guess an external address.
developer-clients.invalid_endpoint: This address is unavailable for safe export. Refresh the details or ask an administrator to check the trusted HTTPS address and exact project path.
developer-clients.invalid_response: Connection details do not match the current project or account. Refresh and verify your organization and project.
developer-clients.boundary: Configuration export does not install a client, connect an account, register an execution tool or start a task. Tokens are never included. Remote clients need a reachable HTTPS address; loopback works only on the same host. Official formats checked on 29 October 2026.
